text: Here the message is its own key: each letter is shifted by another message letter, picked by K3's counting rule. The rule runs in loops, so one known letter forces the next letter round its loop.
When a loop comes back to a known letter, or closes on itself, the forced letter must agree. With the mirror rule every loop is two places long and gives a check at once.
Every start and step, 12 table rules: no setting survives on K4, and none on ten scrambled coppers either. The idea is ruled out by the known letters alone.
